name: @pipeworx/mcp-ebsa

tools.name: ebsa_search
tools.description: Search closed EBSA (Employee Benefits Security Administration) civil-penalty enforcement cases since 2000 — deficient-filer, late-filer and non-filer penalty assessments against ERISA benefit-plan sponsors for their Form 5500 filings. Filter by plan sponsor/administrator name, case type, state, or plan year. Returns the plan, sponsor, case type, close reason/date, and the penalty amount (a DOL-assigned dollar-range bucket, e.g. "over $100,000"). Complements the `form5500` pack, which covers the filings themselves rather than enforcement against them.

sponsor.description: Plan sponsor / administrator name, matched as a substring against both the plan administrator and the plan name.

case_type.description: Case type, e.g. "Deficient Filer", "Late Filer", "Non Filer". Matched as a substring.

state.description: Two-letter or full state name of the plan administrator as DOL records it (e.g. "Texas").

plan_year.description: Plan year of the filing that triggered the case, e.g. 2022.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.

tools.name: ebsa_sponsor
tools.description: Full EBSA civil-penalty enforcement history for one named plan sponsor/administrator, with every closed case and a count by case type. Matches the sponsor against both the plan administrator name and the plan name and reports which one hit. Use to answer whether an employer's benefit plans have a history of filing-compliance penalties.

sponsor.description: Plan sponsor / administrator name, matched against the plan administrator and the plan name.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.

tools.name: ebsa_recent
tools.description: The most recent closed EBSA civil-penalty enforcement actions, newest first, optionally restricted to one case type or state. Returns plan, sponsor, case type, close date/reason and penalty bucket for each. Use for "what EBSA enforcement actions closed recently".

case_type.description: Restrict to one case type, e.g. "Deficient Filer".

state.description: Restrict to one plan-administrator state as DOL records it (e.g. "California").

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.

tools.name: ebsa_coverage
tools.description: Report what the EBSA OCATS enforcement dataset currently covers: its publication date, update frequency and the close-date range of a sample query. Use to check how current the enforcement data is before relying on an absence of cases.

_apiKey.description: Optional. Your own free DOL Open Data Portal key (dataportal.dol.gov); omit it to use the platform key.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-ebsa forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the ebsa pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
